title: Not sure how to explain.
content: I’ve been dreaming of mall world for a long time. I can’t pinpoint when the dreams started, but they have branched into many recurring places in my dreams. I found this sub around two years ago. Ever since, every time I am dreaming of mall world or the surrounding areas, eventually I realize where I am. I usually try to find my phone to take a picture for evidence but it doesn’t work. I wouldn’t call if fully lucid because I don’t necessarily realize that I’m dreaming at that point. Usually things start getting fuzzy and I wake up soon after. Again, it’s hard to explain, but I wasn’t sure I anyone else has experienced this.
